fusions.name: Footing Bite
fusions.desc: Clamps onto the target, which deals 14 damage, stuns it for 1.6 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Moat Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 5 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Flagstone Snare
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, sets a trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage and leaves the enemy [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: The Long Set
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
